نَافِسٌ : see نَفِيسٌ, in three places. ＝
-A2- See also نُفَسَآءُ. ＝
-A3- (tropical:) Smiting with an evil, or envious, eye. (S, M, K.) ＝
-A4- The fifth of the arrows used in the game called المَيْسِر; (S, M, K;) which has five notches; and for which one wins five portions if it be successful, and loses five portions if it be unsuccessful: (Lh, M:) or, as some say, the fourth. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
